data.title: Jazan Health Cluster Sets Guinness World Record for Early Diabetes Detection
data.content:
Jizan, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Jazan Health Cluster has set a Guinness World Record by conducting early diabetes screening tests for 76,007 beneficiaries within 24 hours, ranking first worldwide.
    The initiative was implemented under the diabetes care pathway, one of the pathways of the Saudi Model of Care, in conjunction with World Diabetes Day. It involved the cluster's hospitals, primary healthcare centers, and field teams deployed at several locations. These efforts aimed to reach different segments of society and expand access to early detection services, in line with the Chronic Care System, one of the systems of the Saudi Model of Care.
    The initiative included medical screenings and awareness programs covering diabetes, its causes, associated risk factors, and prevention methods. It also highlighted the importance of adopting healthy lifestyles and undergoing regular check-ups to reduce the risk of complications.
    The initiative reflects the Jazan Health Cluster's efforts to strengthen preventive healthcare and integrate services across its facilities and field teams. These efforts support the objectives of the Saudi Model of Care to reduce chronic diseases and their complications, improve community health, and enhance quality of life.
    
    -- SPA
